message: Don't roll an ad-hoc lead/email filter via inline `python -c`. Use scripts/outreach_batch.py — extend it with --include-archived/--min-score flags if needed. (MISTAKES.md 2026-05-04: Sent to Known-Bad Lead — Notes-Field Filter Gap)

Sending hand-crafted HTML body via raw `send` bypasses the canonical OASIS template path and the geo-rapport feature. Use `send-template` with one of the 3 OASIS template UUIDs. (MISTAKES.md 2026-05-04: Draft Critic vs. OASIS Templates)
